# NOTES ON THE TWO BOOKS (compact reference)

## BOOK 1 of 2: "A Bid for Fortune; Or, Dr. Nikola's Vendetta" by Guy Boothby (Gutenberg #21640)

**Structure:** Part I: Prologue "Dr. Nikola" + Ch I–IX. Part II: Ch I–VI. Ends "THE END".

**Prologue (Imperial Restaurant, Thames Embankment, London):** Manager Mr. McPherson (33 yrs in business) reads a letter from Cuyaba, Brazil, ordering dinner for 4 at 8 p.m., three months ahead, room 22, red-shaded candles, saucer+jug of new milk. Chief bookkeeper Miss O'Sullivan (28). Head waiter Williams. Guests with red-dot cards: 
- **Eastover** (American accent, tall, ~30, Best Dressed; Nashville, Tahupapa, Papeete, Pekin)
- **Prendergast** (next tallest, snow-white hair, smallpox-pitted face; Brussels, Monte Video, Mandalay, Gold Coast)
- **Baxter** (clergyman, undersized, bow legs; Cabul, Nijni Novgorod, Wilcannia, Valparaiso, Nagasaki)
- **Dr. Nikola** arrives (slightly above average height, black hair, olive skin, black eyes; age 33) with black cat in basket.
Nikola orders: Eastover to Sydney on Wednesday boat, meet at Plymouth; Prendergast to Dover→Paris, deliver answer Thursday 2:30 at Charing Cross porch; Baxter is tutor to young Marquis of Beckenham (Duke of Glenbarth's son) at Bournemouth, to foster desire for travel. Target: "Wetherell." Nikola leaves for *Green Sailor* public-house, East India Dock Road. Vendetta: man "immensely rich," L300,000 cheque; plan pays L10,000 each on success.

**Ch I (narrator Richard "Dick" Hatteras):** Thursday Island pearler, 28, 6ft2, 46in chest. Father English, died in schooner *Helen of Troy*; mother died Philippines. Pearling at Thursday Island; L5,000 mining share. Sails Orient liner from Sydney. Sydney: fights con man "Mr. Dorunda Dodson" (real name slip "Dorunda"). Saves **Phyllis Wetherell** (21–22, brown hair, blue eyes) from larrikins in the Domain (Dog, etc.). Her father Hon. Sylvester Wetherell, Colonial Secretary, Potts Point. Hatteras stays at *Quebec* hotel. *Orizaba* sails; they're aboard. Wetherell (white beard) forbids match; Phyllis's letter signed "PHYLLIS." Naples: Wetherells leave; Hatteras proposes at sea; Phyllis says yes.

**Ch II (London):** Hatteras stays at hotel near Strand. Meets Phyllis at British Museum (Egyptian dept.); gives ring. Lunch in French restaurant (Frenchman proprietor); meets Nikola (plays chess with German; then artist), who names cards in his pocket: Edward Braithwaite (Macquarrie St., Sydney), Wetherell, Hatteras. Fly-paper vision: Phyllis crying "Oh, Dick! Dick! come to me!" Wetherells gone to Paris, en route Australia.

**Ch III:** Phyllis's letter: father frightened after seeing someone; left for Paris. Hatteras to Hampshire, New Forest; Lyndhurst Road; Murdlestone (Hall). Uncle **Sir William Hatteras**, miserly, with old servant and wife; cousin **Gwendoline** (deformed, "thing"; old woman). Demands L1,000; Hatteras refuses, insults him. Father's birthplace; Catullus book bought 3 July 1833 at John Burns, Fleet St., 18d. Rectory clergyman: "nothing to be done." Advertisement for yacht *Enchantress* (10 tons), Screw & Matchem, Bournemouth.

**Ch IV:** Bournemouth; hires *Enchantress*. Rescues drowning youth near Alum Chine: **Marquis of Beckenham** (aged ~19, becomes 20 in October; father **Duke of Glenbarth**, "Mad Duke"; house Sandridge Castle / West Cliff). Tutor **Baxter** meets them on beach.

**Ch V:** Duke visits Hatteras at hotel; says Baxter was missionary in South Seas, India. Duke's theory: educate son in seclusion; Hatteras urges travel. Hatteras tells Beckenham tales of Australia. At post office, telegram form shows impression: "LETTER RECEIVED. YOU OMMITTED REVEREDN. THE TRAIN IS LAID, BUT A NEW ELEMENT OF DANGER HAS ARISEN." addressed "Nikola, Green Sailor Hotel, East India Dock Road," signed "Nineveh." Hatteras sends reply to "John Nicholson, Langham Hotel" with "The train is laid... HATTERAS." Baxter asked about Andamans: reacts. Baxter threatens at Bournemouth.

**Ch VI:** Hatteras meets Jim Percival (*Yarraman*) in Trafalgar Sq.; dines aboard. Goes to *Green Sailor*; finds Baxter with Nikola. Nikola tries hypnotism; warns not to sail in *Saratoga*. Letter from Phyllis (Port Said; Prendergast presumes). Letter from Beckenham (sailing *Saratoga* with Baxter). Duke's letter (Earl of Amberley, Governor NSW). Hatteras drugged on train to Plymouth; wakes in Ship and Vulture Hotel, Plymouth; Saturday.

**Ch VII:** Hatteras in Naples; boards Saratoga; Beckenham sea-sick (Baxter gives coffee/drug). Port Said: Beckenham gives half sovereign to lame beggar. Mosque; fight with English tourists; escape over wall. Casino; Nikola glimpsed. Garroted by cord near Greek sign.

**Ch VIII:** Both chained in room with boarded window; Prendergast (white hair, pitted face) jailer; African servant. Mouse-messenger with letter to beggar (cripple, iron/wood crutch); file delivered via pipe; escape from collars.

**Ch IX:** Escape into passage; discover Nikola's den (pickled specimens, weapons; albino dwarf, half-ape boy, Indian bald man, black cat). Nikola returns letters, banknote; releases them blindfolded. Hotel; Saratoga agent says Beckenham came back aboard, Baxter substituted. Hatteras plans with Beckenham (who is secretly the real marquis—plan: take new name, sail to Australia on *Pescadore*).

**PART II Ch I:** *Pescadore* to Williamstown (36 days). Beckenham lethargic. Sydney, General Officer Hotel (Palgrave St.). Newspaper: impostor at Government House; Beckenham's name on passenger list. Theatre: impostor marquise beside Amberley's wife. Wetherell visit: Phyllis says a suitor (impostor) wants her. Phyllis missing; Wetherell thrown out.

**Ch II:** Phyllis kidnapped at Government House ball (sham message of father illness). Wetherell confesses China Pete/stick story (Nikola wants it). Thompson coachman drugged at Canary Bird Hotel by Nikola; clues: ball of envelope "----swell Street, Woolahra," newsagent W. E. Maxwell, Ipswell St.; chloroform bought; "J. Venneage, 22 Calliope Street"; Beckenham found bound in house.

**Ch III:** Beckenham's story: lured by "Mathew Draper" (Nikola's ally) at Botanical Gardens; hatchet, mesmerized; given drug. House 83 Charlemagne St. Clue: rope "seized" (ship), green paint block. Ransom note from "THE MAN WHO KNOWS" (demand L100,000; "little stick from China Pete"). Hatteras makes friend of Miss Tiffins (dressmaker), goods hired by Eastover from Goddard & James; Draper ex-owner of schooner *Merry Duchess*.

**Ch IV:** Plot: fake bags of money; Nikola's men; boat meeting; *Maid of the Mist* barque; trap fails (informed by parlour maid). Hatteras follows woman "Sally" to hideout; hears Phyllis moved to Pipa Lannu. Chartered yacht *Enchantress*? No—McMurtough's steam yacht; Hatteras inherits title: Sir Richard Hatteras (Gwendoline drowned, Sir William died), rent roll L15,000, bank Oceania L5,000 payment. Solicitors Dawson & Gladman.

**Ch V:** Voyage; Wetherell's story of China Pete (murder trial, the stick, L10 million power, Llamaserai in Peking; Nikola's threats; Wetherell's garrotting). Nikola buys/steals stick from Wetherell's safe (Chinese thief convicted). Assault on Pipa Lannu: Phyllis had been held on Nikola's schooner; Wetherell tied to post in cave; stick taken by Nikola. Baxter present on schooner.

**Ch VI (Conclusion):** Phyllis rescued; Hatteras kills/subdues guard; Beckenham best man. Phyllis's Ball account: Baxter escorted her out. Nikola's diamond *collet* card: "Lady Hatteras... Dr. Nikola." Marriage at cathedral; honeymoon Blue Mountains; return via *Orizaba*. Hatteras lives in New Forest; fears Nikola.

## BOOK 2 of 2: "The World Masters" by George Griffith (Gutenberg #38028)

**Prologue (Strassburg, Fisher's Gate, Old Ill river):** Dr. Emil Fargeau (~60, Alsatian, physicist, Univ. of Strassburg). Machine: 3ft, glass cylinder, steel plate 4in square broken by wooden mallet at midnight; wooden cuckoo clock. Discovery: Soul of the World / magnetic tides; to give France mastery. Son **Victor Fargeau** (Uhlan captain, German attaché at Petersburg). Daughter of Bourbons **Adelaide de Condé** (Marquise de Montpensier). Father **Prince Louis Xavier de Condé** (~50, voluntary exile, Prince of Bourbon). Funds: ten 20-mark pieces. Jew money-lender **Reuss Weinthal** (Judenstrasse, Strassburg) holds mortgage/family honour.

**Ch I (Petersburg, German Embassy, 27 Jan):** Ball. Count Valdemar (Russian, Ambassador's aide?) and daughter **Countess Sophie Valdemar** (19, golden-bronze hair, pansy-blue eyes, sensual mouth; chief Third Section daughter, spy). Victor and Adelaide meet in winter garden: "Well, what is your news... ?" "he has succeeded... goes to Paris."

**Ch II:** Fargeau sees French Minister of War (name not given; in Paris), refused proof; minister offers 50 francs; Fargeau cursed France; leaves for Southampton by steamer; leaps overboard with tin box (specifications). Body fished out by yacht *Nadine*.

**Ch III:** Yacht *Nadine*, owner Ernest Shafto Hardress, Viscount Branston (son of Earl of Orrel); guest **Frank Lamson**, D.Sc., M.A. (Cambridge). Body mangled; tin box. Ladies: **Lady Olive** (Hardress's sister, ~25), **Chrysie Vandel** (daughter of Clifford K. Vandel, President of American Electrical Storage Trust, Buffalo). Kipling jabs.

**Ch IV:** Lamson reads papers, is tempted, tells Hardress. Plan: control of world's electricity.

**Ch V:** Dinner at Orrel Court (Southampton, South Downs). Vandel ("Lightning King"). Syndicate "International Magnetic Control Syndicate." Vandel's ambition.

**Ch VI:** Hardress leases Boothia Felix (Canadian govt, L1,000/yr). Chrysie's conditional acceptance: "option on territory."

**Ch VII:** Elsenau spa (Hôtel Wilhelmshof, Thuringian forest); Lord Orrel and Olive meet Prince de Condé (Xavier) and Adelaide. Prince tells Orrel of Fargeau's secret; Orrel recounts tin box story.

**Ch VIII:** Prince collapses; dies after Adelaide's night; brain haemorrhage. Hardress arrives at hotel.

**Ch IX:** Adelaide's diary (locked silver-key book): loves Hardress secretly; hates Chrysie. Aunt **Madame de Condé**.

**Ch X:** Vienna. Hardress tells father he loves Chrysie. Victor & Adelaide; Victor resigns, plans spying for France.

**Ch XI:** Victor in Paris; meets Adelaide at Avenue Neuilly. Count & Sophie visit.

**Ch XII:** General Ducros (Minister of War) dinner with Valdemars; Ducros reveals; Victor offers plan: French Arctic expedition. Sophie gets room access.

**Ch XIII:** Cowes week; Chrysie's suspicion of Adelaide and Sophie; Vandel cables Lamson.

**Ch XIV:** Sophie plans *Nadine* capture via engineer **Edward Williams** (disgruntled, bribed). Plan: *Vlodoya* (Valdemar's yacht) to overtake *Nadine*. Mid-Atlantic piracy; hostages to Polar expedition rendezvous. Lamson's cipher alerts.

**Ch XV:** Storage Works at Port Adelaide (Cape Adelaide) in Boothia Land; tower over Magnetic Pole; absorbers; "disintegrator" death-ray; steel masts across continents. Lamson and Austin Vandel (nephew).

**Ch XVI:** Adelaide letter; Russian ice-breaker *Ivan the Terrible*. Sophie & Adelaide plot; Williams bribed.

**Ch XVII:** Adelaide agrees to help Sophie (after Sophie's blackmail). Oath to spare Hardress & family.

**Ch XVIII:** *Nadine* departs Southampton at night; telegram to Count at Cherbourg from Felice (Adelaide's maid). Vandel's warnings; gun mounted (dynamite gun "Vandelite", liquid gas). Williams sabotages shaft ("grit"); confesses by face.

**Ch XIX–XXII:** Punch "à le Grand Monarque" drugs crew/passengers (Adelaide's brew). Chrysie wakes; Vlodoya chase. Chrysie fires Maxim; Vlodoya crippled; count and Sophie surrender; Vlodoya sunk; Lord Orrel, Hardress take them on board. Dinner; Sophie's and Adelaide's guests status.

**Ch XXIII–XXV:** Circular from Trust (Buffalo) to Europe: capitation fee $1/man/week; one week deadline. Engines start 6 p.m. (Chrysie pulls lever). European electrical failure; Charles Martel's guns burst. Kaiser (Wilhelm) and President Loubet meet at Claridge's; King Edward arbitrates at Marlborough House.

**Ch XXVI–XXVII:** Europe paralyzed; Powers accept King Edward's arbitration. Russian and French squadrons arrive at Adelaide Bay.

**Ch XXVIII–XXX:** Dinner at works; Admirals Nazanoff (Russian) and Dumont (French), Victor Fargeau present. Hardress: "annihilated." Adelaide shoots Hardress (broken thigh), Chrysie (arm wound), Sophie & Victor shoot; Lamson's disintegrator burns Sophie, Adelaide, Victor to bones.

**Ch XXXI:** Battle; Count Valdemar killed by disintegrator at lighthouse. Naval bombardment; French and Russian ships destroyed. Remains boxed: Adelaide & Sophie to Madame de Bourbon / Valdemar's brother.

**Epilogue:** Hardress and Chrysie recover; Lamson announces Powers' surrender; King Edward arbitration rules. Chrysie: "We four... run the world." Kiss contract.
